description: Four small plastic cups (blue, yellow, red, and green) are lined up on the table, with a yellow squeeze bottle to the right and a blue scrub pad in front. The left hand holds the blue cup while the right hand presses the blue scrub pad against its side and rim, rubbing and rotating the cup slightly; then the right hand sets the scrub pad down and the left hand places the blue cup back in line with the other cups, releasing it.
